title: Tickets, Seats and Trouble
label: ch:ta-tickets-seats-and-trouble
canDo: I can buy a ticket with … oru cīṭṭu koṭuṅkaḷ, ask for a seat (irukkai) and when a train leaves, and report a problem: a bag that is missing (kāṇavillai), a passport that is lost, a bus I missed.

payoff.summary: Complete the last lesson of chapter 289: buy a ticket, ask for a seat and a time, and report something lost or missed.
